== Radio Free Decipher Broadcasts 24, 29 and 30 (2026-10-26) ==
Added paragraphs from the full Internet Archive copies (youtube-PBEi5cn8qds, 4Wci5TkoXNg, iGgiAkH-fd0). These are 23:52, 24:48 and 11:05 long and decode end to end. The text only uses lines that are clear in the machine transcripts.

These hearings are not on the article:
* Broadcast 24, about 13:23–13:35: the show says (as heard) "Felicity Shagwell's 65 Corvette Stingray" would be "right down there". It is not clear whether that means DecipherCon. Broadcast 29, about 13:26–13:42, mentions a "CIA 1" licence plate and something "on display".
* Broadcast 24, about 15:41: Carol Wisely says (as heard) Kendrick Summers called the Austin Powers team events "Shagfest".
* Broadcast 29, about 12:00: an engineer, heard as "Ryan Johnson", is mentioned with the Iron Man event.
* Broadcast 30, about 2:33: the Austin Powers Road Tour events are heard as "Daddy's ... Pants" events. I cannot make out the full name.
